# tree-sitter-make for MoonBit

Makefile grammar for tree-sitter.

This module packages [tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-make](https://github.com/tree-sitter-grammars/tree-sitter-make) v1.1.1 for
[moonbit-community/treesitter](https://github.com/moonbit-community/treesitter), the pure MoonBit
port of Tree-sitter. The parse tables are generated from the grammar's
`src/grammar.json` by the port's generator, which produces the same tables
as `tree-sitter generate` 0.28.0.

The module version 0.101.1 stands for the grammar's release v1.1.1: Mooncakes
only accepts `0.x.y` versions for now, so releases `M.m.p` with `M >= 1`
are published as `0.(100*M + m).p`.

## API

The package mirrors the grammar's Rust binding (`bindings/rust/lib.rs`):

| MoonBit | Rust |
| --- | --- |
| `language() -> @treesitter.Language` | `LANGUAGE` |
| `node_types : String` | `NODE_TYPES` (`src/node-types.json`) |
| `highlights_query : String` | `HIGHLIGHTS_QUERY` (`queries/highlights.scm`) |

## Usage

```sh
moon add moonbit-community/tree-sitter-make
```

In `moon.pkg`:

```text
import {
  "moonbit-community/treesitter",
  "moonbit-community/tree-sitter-make" @tree_sitter_make,
}
```

```mbt check
///|
test "parse make" {
  let language = @tree_sitter_make.language()
  let parser = @treesitter.Parser::new()
  parser.set_language(language)
  let source =
    #|ifeq ("string $(sort 1 2 3)", 'string ${VAR}')
    #|endif
    #|
    #|ifneq (arg0, arg1)
    #|endif
    #|
    #|ifdef var
    #|endif
    #|
    #|ifndef var
    #|endif
    #|
  guard parser.parse(@utf8.encode(source)) is Some(tree) else {
    fail("parse failed")
  }
  let root = tree.root_node()
  assert_false(root.has_error())
  assert_false(root.to_sexp().contains("ERROR"))
}
```
